title: danae androgyna
intro: Danae androgyna, commonly known as the Ladys' Bedstraw, is a flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Danae androgyna include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
